notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Changed NoSee monster's surrounding darkness away from volumetric lighting as it was causing crashes for many players.
[/list]
[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed crash related to NoSee monster.
[*]Fixed monsters' pathfinding getting stuck in certain rooms.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Changed NoSee monster's surrounding darkness away from volumetric lighting as it was causing crashes for many players.
[*]Fixed monsters' pathfinding getting stuck in certain rooms.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.content:
[list]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]

[*]Changed NoSee spirit's sound to be muffled or even entirely negated if behind an object or wall to allow for hearing distinction between floors.

[*]Changed crouch functionality to allow it to cancel toggled sprint for quality of life.

[*]Changed filing cabinet drawers to become non-interactable once they are closed properly to allow clarity when checking which drawers are properly closed.

[u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u]
[*]Fixed ability to turn torch on when it was being put away.
[*]Fixed HUD element being selected when tab was pressed.
[*]Fixed wrong monkeys being displayed on loading screens.
[*]Fixed tutorial option not being toggleable on gamepad.
[/list]
